header: Two to four figures, each on a card
lead: The standard row of results. Editors type every figure, and nothing is measured or fetched when the page loads.
note: Put the reporting date in this note. Readers need to know when a figure was true.

metrics.title: Cards, minimum
metrics.text: For a single figure, use Big Number.

metrics.title: Cards, maximum
metrics.text: More than four cards no longer read as one row.

metrics.title: Column below 640px
metrics.text: On phones the cards stack, whatever the column setting says.
